notes: The GYM theme pack and a News page
changes: NEW  GYM theme pack (paid, unlocks with a code): pick workout tasks or make your own, run a workout timer while your music plays, and get motivational quotes.
NEW  Level up from Beginner to Pure Workout. Every task you finish adds to your stats, and the people around you react differently at every level.
NEW  Motivational quotes written offline, or fresh ones from Claude or Gemini if you add your own key (your choice).
NEW  This News page: what changed after each update, a note from the owner, and a notice when a new version is on the website.
message:
Thank you for using HyDeck. I make it myself, so every download means a lot. The GYM pack is the part I am proudest of: I hope it gets you moving, one rep at a time. Tell me what you want next, and I will do my best to build it.
— Hyper Tech Widget
